

== Premium Edition source, dates and card articles ==
The [[Virtual Set 1: Legacy (Premium Edition)|Premium Edition overview]] and its twelve card articles use the official [[Media:VirtualCards1Premium.pdf|Virtual Set #1 Premium Edition PDF]] and the corresponding source slips, rather than wiki reconstructions of the later 2006 state. Printed lower-card text/statistics and the sheet legend are kept distinct from information inherited from each underlying Decipher face. The source prints “Bo Shek (V)” with a space and a uniqueness dot on the Sai’torr Kal Fas slip; those details are preserved.

The footer reads “SWCCG Player’s Committee 2002”, while the inspected PDF creation metadata is 3 February 2005. These are separate source facts, not a demonstrated release day. The precise publication date and order remain unresolved. The Premium Edition must not be called a 2002 release solely from the footer, or a February 2005 release solely from metadata.

Each slip has a distinct publication article linked from the edition and [[Virtual Set 1: Legacy|Set 1]] presentation and related versions. This documents an official published presentation; it does not establish another gameplay implementation or allocate GEMP IDs. A later faithful wiki reconstruction would illustrate the relevant source edition rather than become another historical PC release by itself. Exact field evidence and version membership checks are retained in the #362 batch. ~~~~
